title: Pure Orcust
summary: Orcust cards only, with generic staples; the World Legacy cards the Orcusts name are left out. Girsu, the Orcust Mekk-Knight sends an Orcust card to the GY and can make a Link-1 or Link-2 on its own. From there the Orcust monsters banish themselves from the GY to summon each other, and Orcustrated Babel lets you do that on the opponent's turn. Every Orcust summon locks you to DARK monsters for the turn. The 2025 Links lead the Extra Deck. Galatea-I, the Orcust Automaton is a Link-1 that searches Orcustrated Babel and revives itself, and Enlilgirsu, the Orcust Mekk-Knight recovers a banished Orcust card and steals a monster. Galatea and Dingirsu set up Orcust Crescendo and the follow-up.
main: Girsu, the Orcust Mekk-Knight
Starter: mills an Orcust card; makes a token on an empty field.
Orcust Harp Horror
Banishes itself from the GY to summon an Orcust from the Deck.
Orcust Cymbal Skeleton
Banishes itself from the GY to revive an Orcust.
Orcust Brass Bombard
Tuner: banishes itself to summon an Orcust from the hand.
Orcust Knightmare
Banishes itself to mill a DARK Machine.
Orcustrated Babel
Field Spell: Orcust GY effects become Quick Effects.
Orcustrated Return
Sends an Orcust to the GY to draw 2.
Orcustrated Einsatz
Mills or banishes an Orcust when they summon.
Orcust Crescendo
Counter Trap: negates and banishes while you control an Orcust Link.
Orcustrated Core
Protects your Orcust cards from targeting and destruction.
Orcustrated Release
Tributes two Machines to revive monsters.
extra: Newest Link-1: searches Orcustrated Babel and revives itself.
Newest Link-4: recovers a banished Orcust card and steals a monster.
Link-2: sets an Orcust Spell/Trap from the Deck.
Link-3: sends a linked monster of theirs to the GY.
Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star
Rank 8 made from an Orcust Link: sends a card to the GY.
Link-2: Quick Effect Link Summons during opponent's Main Phase and gives the summoned monster effect-destruction immunity.
Link-2: banishes a card on the field/GY on summon and banishes 2 face-up monsters until the End Phase as a Quick Effect.
Link-3: discards 1 card on summon to shuffle any card on the field into the Deck, and draws cards if co-linked.
